Introduction

USPEER is a seven-member girl group under WM Entertainment.

On March 24, 2025, WM Entertainment launched SNS accounts and posted a logo motion revealing their name to be "USPEER". The same day, an article confirmed the group's debut for the first half of 2025.

Their name, "USPEER", is a combination of "US", meaning "we", and "SPEER", meaning "question" or "ask", and can be explained as "we'll understand the nature of the world where we'll be together and create a better future".

The seven members names were revealed on March 31, 2025, in a Twitter post teasing their debut reality show, called "RUN UP!". Three days later, on April 3, 2025, the seven members were properly introduced to be Sian, Seoyu, Daon, Roa, Chaena, Soee, and Yeowon, in the first episode of the show.

USPEER made their debut on June 4, 2025, with the release of their first single album called "SPEED ZONE".
